title: Introduction to Full-Text Search knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Introduction to Full-Text Search”?
options: Specialized search and spatial capabilities should be selected for a defined query workload. Confirm supported data types, collation/tokenization or spatial reference system, and the applicable index limitations for the server version.
It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.
questions.answer_key: Specialized search and spatial capabilities should be selected for a defined query workload. Confirm supported data types, collation/tokenization or spatial reference system, and the applicable index limitations for the server version.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains: Specialized search and spatial capabilities should be selected for a defined query workload. Confirm supported data types, collation/tokenization or spatial reference system, and the applicable index limitations for the server version.

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Introduction to Full-Text Search” safely?
options: Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
Create a small synthetic article set, build a FULLTEXT index in the lab, and compare a natural-language or Boolean search.
questions.answer_key: Create a small synthetic article set, build a FULLTEXT index in the lab, and compare a natural-language or Boolean search.
questions.explanation: Create a small synthetic article set, build a FULLTEXT index in the lab, and compare a natural-language or Boolean search. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.

questions.prompt: Before relying on an example for “Introduction to Full-Text Search”, what should be verified?
options: Ignore version notes and infer behavior from an unrelated database engine.
Assume a successful connection means the query and data model are correct.
Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
Run a broad production change before checking the current state.
questions.answer_key: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
questions.explanation: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
